name: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-gb200-agentx-pd
objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs

sweeps.name: colocated
sweeps.narrative: Nine TP8 instances should lead the colocated shapes, since wider dp groups paid hundreds of ms of ITL on the 64-GPU rack.

sweeps.name: colocated-tuned
sweeps.narrative: A bigger token budget with a long-prefill cap should hold ITL to higher load, narrowing what P/D can win.

sweeps.name: pd-ratio
sweeps.narrative: Decode-heavy ratios should win on AgentX, since cached prefixes leave only a short uncached tail to prefill per turn.

sweeps.name: pd-always
sweeps.narrative: Splitting every request should trail the threshold arms, because a turn with a cached prefix pays a handoff for little prefill.

sweeps.name: pd-wide-decode
sweeps.narrative: TP16 decode instances should hold ITL at higher load than TP8 ones, trading batch slots for faster steps.

sweeps.name: pd-wide-prefill
sweeps.narrative: TP16 prefill instances should cut TTFT on long cold turns but cost decode slots, so they should lose on ITL-bound load.

sweeps.name: pd-pool-engine
sweeps.narrative: A 32k prefill budget should matter on the prefill-light layout and a decode-pool prefill cap on the decode-heavy one.

sweeps.name: pd-decode-cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: Full graph capture on the decode pool should lower ITL by a few percent, with FULL_DECODE_ONLY matching FULL there.

sweeps.name: routing
sweeps.narrative: Prefix affinity should beat load-only scorers, and by more across nine instances than three.
